name: emit_readout
description: Emit a structured, investor-relevant readout for one oncology clinical trial.

nct_id.description: The trial's NCT identifier, copied verbatim.

indication.description: Concise tumor type + biomarker/line if stated, e.g. 'EGFR+ NSCLC, 2L' or 'higher-risk MDS, 1L'.

modality.description: Primary therapeutic modality of the investigational agent(s). Use 'combination' only when two distinct modalities are co-equal.

primary_endpoint_type.description: Category of the primary outcome measure(s).

sponsor_type.description: Classify the lead sponsor. 'large pharma' = top-20 global pharma; 'biotech' = smaller commercial sponsor; map sponsor_class OTHER/NIH/NETWORK to academic/government appropriately.

est_readout.description: Estimated primary readout window derived from primary_completion_date, as 'H1 YYYY' / 'H2 YYYY', or 'unknown' if absent.

risk_flags.description: Investor-relevant risk flags supported by the record. Empty array if none apply.

investor_note.description: <=2 sentences: the catalyst-relevant takeaway — what this trial would prove, for whom, and what to watch. No hype, no fabricated facts.
